jobs.title: System Integration Specialist
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience in electrical or electronic system integration Background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Avionics, or equivalent practical experience Experience working with wiring, connectors, harnesses, and electrical debugging

jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline At least 5 years of relevant experience in system engineering, aircraft development, unmanned systems, autonomous systems, or other complex multidisciplinary products Experience working across the complete product development lifecycle
